items.rationale: The original _normalize_requested_path function performed only a single unquote pass, allowing double-encoded traversal sequences like %252e%252e%252f (../) to bypass the string-prefix '..' check. Additionally, absolute paths starting with '/' were stripped before validation. The fix implements iterative URL decoding until stable, validates the original path for absolute/drive-qualified patterns before normalization, and checks each path segment for '..' after full normalization.
Same fix as SARIF-PY-TRAVERSAL-001 addresses the encoded separator and symlink escape vectors. Nested exports remain functional.
JWT key rotation is a separate concern; per appsec_review.md, do not fold into this hotfix.
JWT material rotation deferred per appsec guidance; outside scope of path traversal hotfix.
